about: Golden stories for the pre-publish self-check (agent_reach/daily/golden.py). Each case states what the gates must do with it. Cases marked source '2026-10-10 edition export' are verbatim from that export. Never edit an expectation to make the run pass: change the gate, or explain the change in the commit.

cases.why: Defect 1, live shape: the summary element is omitted
cases.headline: Gigabyte's latest BIOS update hints at Intel's Raptor Lake Next Launch in 2027

cases.why: Defect 1, export shape: the summary is the headline repeated
cases.headline: Gigabyte's latest BIOS update hints at Intel's Raptor Lake Next Launch in 2027
summary: Gigabyte's latest BIOS update hints at Intel's Raptor Lake Next Launch in 2027.

cases.why: Defect 2: the summary only restates the headline
cases.headline: Artificial intelligence and social integration paradox
summary: Artificial intelligence and social integration paradox.

cases.why: Defect 3: a prompt fragment opens the summary
cases.headline: micro1 Commits $1bn to Buy Company Data for Training AI Agents
summary: Exceptions that require judgment micro1 will spend $1bn in 12 months buying company data to train AI agents, financed by Citi and Hercules.

cases.why: Defect 4: the headline says New York, the summary says Fresno
cases.headline: NYC man shot by ICE still has bullet in body, lawyers say
summary: The incident occurred early Friday in Fresno.

cases.why: Defect 5, export shape: bait opener, Title Case, summary is the headline
cases.headline: We Might Be Cooked, As These Vibe-Coded Web Browser Ports Of Halo, The Simpsons: Hit And Run, And GTA: Vice City Seem To Work Perfectly
summary: We Might Be Cooked, As These Vibe-Coded Web Browser Ports Of Halo, The Simpsons: Hit And Run, And GTA: Vice City Seem To Work Perfectly.

cases.why: Defect 5, live shape: no summary

cases.why: A sound summary passes
cases.headline: Fed holds rates steady and signals one cut this year
summary: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rate unchanged on Wednesday and projected a single quarter-point cut before the end of the year, citing slower hiring.
cases.lead: The Federal Reserve kept rates where they were.

cases.why: The same incident placed in the same city is not a contradiction
cases.headline: NYC man shot by ICE still has bullet in body, lawyers say
summary: Lawyers for the man said on Friday that a bullet remains in his body after he was shot by an immigration agent in New York City, and that he has been denied treatment for the wound.

cases.why: A borough inside the headline's city is the same place
cases.headline: Man shot by ICE agent in NYC, officials say
summary: Officials said the shooting happened early Friday in Brooklyn, and the man was taken to a hospital where he is listed in stable condition, according to the police.

cases.why: A city inside the headline's state is the same place
cases.headline: California wildfire forces evacuations near Fresno
summary: Fire crews in California said the blaze grew overnight and forced several hundred residents out of their homes near Fresno, where shelters opened at two schools on Friday morning.

cases.why: 'Gulf of Mexico' is not Mexico
cases.headline: Tropical storm forms in the Gulf of Mexico
summary: Forecasters said the storm formed on Thursday in the Gulf of Mexico and is expected to strengthen before it reaches the coast of Louisiana over the weekend, with heavy rain likely.

cases.why: 'Fed' and 'Federal Reserve' are one organisation
cases.headline: Fed officials split on the pace of rate cuts
summary: Several Federal Reserve officials said on Tuesday they favour moving slowly on rate cuts, while others argued that weaker hiring justifies a faster pace before the end of the year.

cases.why: Quoted text in a headline is never altered
cases.headline: Mayor says city is "Open For Business" after the storm
summary: The mayor told reporters on Monday that the downtown district reopened after the storm and that most shops and restaurants were serving customers again, though some streets stay closed.
cases.normalized_headline: Mayor says city is "Open For Business" after the storm

cases.why: A bait opener is stripped from an otherwise sound story
cases.headline: Wow, Ferry Strike Halts Island Service
summary: Ferry workers began a strike on Tuesday over pay, and the operator said service on all island routes is halted until talks resume, leaving residents without supplies by sea.
cases.lead: Ferry workers began a strike on Tuesday that halts island service.

cases.why: A trailing exclamation mark is removed
cases.headline: Local team wins the championship!
summary: The team beat its rivals 3-1 on Saturday night to win the regional championship for the first time in twelve years, and thousands of fans filled the main square afterwards.

cases.why: Trailing dots are removed
cases.headline: Study finds coffee drinkers live longer...
summary: Researchers who followed 40,000 adults for ten years reported that people who drank two cups of coffee a day were less likely to die during that period, though the study could not prove cause.
cases.normalized_headline: Study finds coffee drinkers live longer

cases.why: Title Case becomes sentence case, acronyms and the allowlist kept
cases.headline: NASA Delays Moon Mission Launch By Two Weeks
summary: NASA said on Thursday that the launch of its crewed moon mission was delayed by two weeks to allow engineers more time to inspect a fuel line, and a new date will be announced soon.
cases.normalized_headline: NASA delays moon mission launch by two weeks

cases.why: A model preamble opens the summary
cases.headline: Company recalls two million vehicles
summary: Here is a summary of the article: the company recalled two million vehicles on Monday because of a faulty brake sensor, the regulator said in a statement released on Monday morning.

cases.why: A summary that repeats the headline's words and adds nothing
cases.headline: Hackers obtain counterfeit TLS certificates for Google and Microsoft
summary: Hackers have obtained counterfeit TLS certificates for Google and Microsoft, security researchers said, according to the report.
